<svg width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status Bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="24" font-family="Inter, Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1D1B20">9:41</text>
    <rect x="312" y="14" width="4" height="8" fill="#1D1B20"/>
    <rect x="318" y="11" width="4" height="11" fill="#1D1B20"/>
    <rect x="324" y="8" width="4" height="14" fill="#1D1B20"/>
    <rect x="330" y="5" width="4" height="17" fill="#1D1B20"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="13" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="13" x2="352" y2="13" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="9" x2="348" y2="17" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="8" width="20" height="10" rx="2" ry="2" fill="none" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="381" y="11" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#1D1B20"/>
    <rect x="363" y="10" width="14" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#1D1B20"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="52" width="390" height="1" fill="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <g transform="translate(16,70)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="48" height="48" rx="24" fill="#F6F7F4"/>
      <polyline points="20,15 12,24 20,33" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <line x1="13" y1="24" x2="29" y2="24" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <text x="76" y="92" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">Convert</text>
    <text x="16" y="136" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Convert currency</text>
    <text x="16" y="159" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">Check the fee and guaranteed rate before you send.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Source / Destination card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="15" y="178" width="360" height="250" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <rect x="17" y="180" width="360" height="250" rx="20" fill="#000000" opacity="0.03"/>
    <text x="31" y="206" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">You pay</text>

    <!-- SGD field -->
    <g>
      <rect x="28" y="216" width="334" height="72" rx="14" fill="#FEFEFE" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <text x="44" y="236" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#454745">Amount from</text>
      <text x="44" y="268" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">S$ 500.00</text>
      <g transform="translate(284,229)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="62" height="44" rx="22" fill="#163300"/>
        <text x="31" y="27" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">SGD</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- swap icon -->
    <g transform="translate(168,294)">
      <circle cx="15" cy="15" r="15" fill="#F2F5EF" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1"/>
      <polyline points="9,12 15,6 21,12" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <polyline points="21,18 15,24 9,18" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- JPY field -->
    <g>
      <rect x="28" y="326" width="334" height="72" rx="14" fill="#FEFEFE" stroke="#0E0F0C1F" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="44" y="346" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#454745">Recipient gets</text>
      <text x="44" y="378" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">¥55,123</text>
      <g transform="translate(284,339)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="62" height="44" rx="22" fill="#F3F5F2" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
        <text x="31" y="27" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">JPY</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <text x="31" y="416" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Balance available: S$ 2,184.77</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Rate Summary -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="466" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Conversion summary</text>
    <text x="325" y="466" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">Guaranteed rate</text>

    <rect x="15" y="482" width="360" height="214" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <rect x="28" y="496" width="334" height="1" fill="#0E0F0C1F"/>

    <text x="28" y="522" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">You send</text>
    <text x="350" y="522" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">S$ 500.00</text>

    <text x="28" y="556" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">Fee</text>
    <text x="350" y="556" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">S$ 3.21</text>

    <text x="28" y="590" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">Exchange rate</text>
    <text x="350" y="590" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">1 SGD = 110.37 JPY</text>

    <text x="28" y="624" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">Arrives by</text>
    <text x="350" y="624" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Tomorrow, 4:20 PM</text>

    <rect x="28" y="642" width="334" height="1" fill="#0E0F0C1F"/>

    <text x="28" y="668" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#454745">Rate guaranteed for 2h</text>
    <circle cx="303" cy="662" r="8" fill="#9FE870"/>
    <polyline points="299,662 302,665 307,659" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="350" y="668" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">Protects you from changes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Fees / Extra note card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="15" y="708" width="360" height="86" rx="18" fill="#163300" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="31" y="728" width="40" height="40" rx="20" fill="#163300"/>
    <path d="M45 737 h12 v6 h-4 l6 8 h-5 l-5 -6 h-4 z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="84" y="746" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Transparent fees</text>
    <text x="84" y="766" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">Your money is converted at the guaranteed rate, with no hidden markup.</text>
    <g transform="translate(312,731)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="46" height="28" rx="14" fill="#9FE870"/>
      <text x="23" y="18" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">Live</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary CTA -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="808" width="358" height="1" fill="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <g transform="translate(16,756)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="358" height="48" rx="24" fill="#163300"/>
      <text x="179" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Review conversion</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom Nav -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="773" width="390" height="71" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <g transform="translate(0,779)">
      <!-- Home -->
      <g transform="translate(12,4)">
        <rect x="0" y="10" width="24" height="16" rx="2" fill="#163300"/>
        <polygon points="12,0 0,10 24,10" fill="#163300"/>
        <text x="12" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">Home</text>
      </g>
      <!-- Card -->
      <g transform="translate(89,4)">
        <rect x="0" y="6" width="24" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="12" x2="24" y2="12" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <text x="12" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#868685">Card</text>
      </g>
      <!-- Send -->
      <g transform="translate(166,4)">
        <polygon points="2,14 22,4 16,14 22,24" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <line x1="4" y1="14" x2="16" y2="14" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <text x="12" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#868685">Send</text>
      </g>
      <!-- Recipients -->
      <g transform="translate(243,4)">
        <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <rect x="5" y="17" width="14" height="8" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <text x="12" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#868685">Recipients</text>
      </g>
      <!-- Manage -->
      <g transform="translate(322,4)">
        <rect x="2" y="6" width="6" height="18" rx="1.5" fill="#868685"/>
        <rect x="10" y="10" width="6" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#868685"/>
        <rect x="18" y="3" width="6" height="21" rx="1.5" fill="#868685"/>
        <text x="12" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#868685">Manage</text>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative accent elements -->
  <g opacity="0.9">
    <circle cx="346" cy="123" r="4" fill="#9FE870"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="123" r="4" fill="#163300"/>
    <circle cx="366" cy="123" r="4" fill="#9FE870"/>
  </g>
</svg>
